title: Registries and scholarly publication — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Simulation instrument only; not a substitute for external registry submission or journal peer review.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: All three panel roles converged independently on approval with minor findings. Convergence centered on official MCP Registry schema validity, Glama/Smithery manifest correctness, draft JOSS paper and CITATION.cff alignment, strict crate publication firewalls, dry-run safety guards in submission scripts, and truthful claim boundaries.
convergence_vectors: Official MCP Registry schema conformance in server.json
Draft JOSS paper adherence to scholarly open-source standards
Zero unwrap/expect and non-publishable crate firewalls across all 30 crates
Honest prepared_not_submitted state in registry status
divergence_vectors: Evaluation of future automated vs manual JOSS review submission workflows
Timing of Zenodo archive reservation relative to release candidate builds

panel_recommendations: Maintain strict deny-by-default policy on crate publication until version 1.0 maturity gates.
Keep dry-run defaults active for all external registry submission tooling.
Preserve exact bibliographic alignment between CITATION.cff and registry paper drafts.
